summary: The regime remains strong physical/capex demand versus restrictive long-duration financing. Official Fed H.15 shows the Aug 21 10Y at 4.69% and 30Y at 5.23%; technology finished the week lower. Diesel/refined-product scarcity remains exceptional. The major weekend incremental signal is Alibaba's US$10.2bn Hong Kong equity placement explicitly to fund full-stack AI capacity, confirming that China AI infrastructure capex remains aggressive while simultaneously highlighting financing intensity.

usRates.read: Long-end yields remain the main valuation brake on high-multiple AI infrastructure, concept nuclear and humanoid robotics even while their demand backdrop remains strong.

fx.read: USD/MYR around 4.04 is not a thesis-changing move for Malaysian data-centre/electrical names, but imported equipment and working-capital sensitivity remain relevant.

energy.read: Refined products remain the stronger signal than crude alone. US diesel crack spreads exceeded $100/bbl during the week as Middle Eastern/Russian disruptions met historically tight distillate inventories; retain tactical complex-refiner preference.

riskAssets.read: The weekly selloff shows the discount-rate risk is real even when AI/industrial operating evidence is strong. Avoid treating backlog growth as permission to ignore entry valuation.

chinaAI.event: Alibaba announced a US$10.2bn/HK$80bn Hong Kong share placement for full-stack AI capabilities.
chinaAI.read: Bullish read-through for China compute, power, cooling and grid demand; bearish/disciplining read-through for AI capital intensity and dilution/financing dependence. Prefer differentiated infrastructure suppliers over broad platform exposure when economics are cleaner.

uranium.read: Long-term contracting signal remains firmer than spot. No uranium hierarchy change.

nextTests: Alibaba placement allocation and China AI supplier read-through
powerStackImplication: Stay concentrated in profitable physical bottlenecks with backlog, pricing power and cash flow. China AI financing adds demand evidence but strengthens the case for power/cooling/grid picks-and-shovels rather than indiscriminate AI beta. Maintain tactical refining strength and keep long-duration concept names below the core layer while yields remain near current levels.
